Al Boraq Automobiles became Porsche's authorised importer in Qatar in 2005, with Salman Jassim Al Darwish serving as chairman as its Doha facilities opened the following year. He has remained the business's public leader through showroom expansion, product launches and the introduction of electric-vehicle charging partnerships, combining chairmanship with day-to-day chief executive responsibility.

Al Darwish also leads Al Adiyat Automobiles, the official Qatari dealer for INEOS Grenadier off-road vehicles. These roles place automotive retail and distribution at the centre of his documented business career. Al Boraq's opening involved Mohammad Jassem Al Darwish and Abdallah Jassem Al Darwish as partners, but their individual relationships, current stakes and any transfer of family wealth remain undisclosed.
